__comment: Improved Pillager Outpost as a small chance instead of a replacement. IPO overwrites minecraft:pillager_outpost/base_plate with a plate whose jigsaw only leads to its own towers; kubejs/data puts the vanilla plate back at that id and keeps IPO's plate as ipo:pillager_outpost/base_plate. The plate picks the tower: vanilla 7, IPO 1 (1 outpost in 8 is an IPO tower). Retune in pool_config.json.
name: minecraft:pillager_outpost/base_plates
